message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored slugify, which strips every non-`[a-z0-9]` character, so `è` and `û` were dropped outright. I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`: its header says not to edit it by hand, and `src/shop/product-url.js` uses it too. Instead, `postSlug` in `src/blog/slug.js` now decomposes accents (NFD) and removes the combining marks before calling slugify.

Shop product URLs still drop accented letters, since I left them alone. If you want them fixed too, the same normalization could go in `src/shop/product-url.js`.
